conventions.close_confirmation_execution: Idealized boundary, not a guaranteed executable fill
conventions.closing_violation: LONG Close <= stop known at Open; SHORT Close >= stop known at Open
conventions.delayed_trigger_availability: Completed Close plus60 minutes, then next eligible Open; three-session trigger horizon; no restart or reentry
conventions.next_open_commitment: Unconditional once Close violated; later stop revision cannot rescind exit
